blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Forest Glen. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: The name buyers see on listings, "Forest Glen BS," is a board sub-area tag (BS = Burnaby South); the park, schools and streets use Forest Glen without the tag.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The towers and the low-rise stock fall in different districts of the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026 (Bylaw No. 14815): its district list runs from Townhouse District (R2) and Low-Rise Apartment (R3, R4) to High-Rise Apartment 2 District (R8), so the Hazel Street towers and a Denbigh Avenue low-rise are not under the same district rules.

Depreciation reports are the age-split issue here: the Province's strata page tracks updated depreciation report requirements effective July 1, 2024, so a 1990s Hazel Street tower and a 2020s tower are read on the same five-year cycle but start from very different building systems.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The bus runs on Forest Glen's own streets, not only at the station: TransLink route 116 runs between Metrotown Station and Edmonds Station — the local route a Nelson Avenue or McMurray Avenue owner uses for trips that do not start at the SkyTrain.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The City's 2026 financial plan held water increases at 0% and raised sewer about $14 for a condo, which is the increase a Hazel Street strata owner sees flow through the strata's utility costs.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: The R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus now terminates at Metrotown Station: TransLink states it provides frequent, all-day service between the North Shore and Burnaby, every 6 to 7 minutes in weekday peak hours and every 10 to 15 minutes off-peak.
Kingsway is the east–west arterial for the low-rise streets; the City's scramble-crossing project at Central Boulevard is at the station end of that trip, not on the residential streets themselves.

blocks.text: Forest Glen Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Building age is the risk split on Hazel Street: towers from different decades carry different envelope, elevator and plumbing cycles, and the only published check is each strata's depreciation report and Form B — no municipal source publishes a tower-by-tower condition figure.

Form and character of any new multi-family project here is governed by the Zoning Bylaw 2026's Form and Character Development Permit Area guidelines, which state a development permit is not required for permitted uses in the R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing District or for R1 uses proposed in an R2 Townhouse district, except supportive housing — relevant to small infill beside the low-rise stock.

blocks.text: Forest Glen home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

57 condos sold in Forest Glen with a median price of $640,000 (the middle half sold between $550,000 and $755,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $725 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median strata fee of $509 a month. 6 townhomes sold in Forest Glen with a median price of $846,500, taking a median of 14 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $778 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $381 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Forest Glen?
faq.a: 66, in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® month-end figures for October 2026. Listings change every day; Jared can tell you what is available now.

faq.q: Is Forest Glen a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: Forest Glen condos and townhomes sold at a 12% sales ratio in October 2026, a balanced market on the reports’ scale (under 12% favours buyers, over 20% favours sellers).

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Forest Glen from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Forest Glen accounted for 42 of the 916 condos and townhomes sold across Burnaby from June to October 2026.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Forest Glen sell for?
faq.a: The median condo sale in Forest Glen was $640,000, across 57 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Forest Glen?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 38 days. At the median, sale prices were 96.7% of list, and 5% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
